Selection cost. score − 0.5·θ⁴ − 1.4·dcom — graspness from the network, minus a steep penalty on tilt from vertical (keeps the pick reachable and calibration-robust), minus distance from the object's centroid (keeps it near the centre of mass rather than the rim). Candidates and their 180° twins are geometrically pre-filtered first, so IK is checked on ≈25 poses, not 400 — the whole ranking runs in ~2 s on Thor.

Box vs. bottle. The box gives an ordinary distribution; the bottle pins every candidate at 0.294 — CGN's ACRONYM/ShapeNet training is bottle- and mug-heavy, so a clean round cross-section saturates the graspness head. Same as the real re-shot cup in Phase 2c. Both winners are near-vertical top-down pinches across a ≈5 cm span, well inside the 10 cm gripper — chosen by the cost field, not by a hand-set "top / side" mode.
